new_matches.title: Customer Success Partner
new_matches.description: Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region. Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA. Role Summary The Customer Success Partner (CSP) is a key role responsible for providing direct impact on revenue retention by owning the post-sales customer experience and engagement, driving adoption and value realization for our subscription customers. Ultimately, the CSP represents the customers’ interests in realizing value from Property Finder digital products and solutions. The CSP will focus on key accounts for which they will be responsible for leveraging data around customer health to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive customer outcomes, client satisfaction and overall revenue growth. The CSP will also partner closely with Sales to help them achieve their revenue targets and identify future growth opportunities. Strong relationship building skills and a passion for helping customers succeed, combined with an affinity for metrics and analytics, are key to success in this role. Key Responsibilities Establish strong relationships with assigned customers, serving as their dedicated point of contact for all questions and concerns. Represent best practices regarding PF products and services to the customer to ensure maximum value from their investment. Consult with clients to jointly establish goals and the metrics used to evaluate progress towards those goals to align expectations for maximum client success. Monitor health metrics to conduct reviews with clients using established metrics and reporting to ensure they are on track to meet goals and to remedy results that are off track. Identify CSQL’s during customer check-ins to support revenue growth and upsell opportunities. Leverage technology to increase efficiencies and make processes scalable. Partner with sales to provide needed support and resources throughout the customer’s lifecycle so they can achieve revenue targets. Desired Qualifications Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or science major. 2 to 3 years of experience in a SAAS/Subscription environment. Customer Service or Live Operations management Experience. Exceptional oral and written communication skills internally and externally. Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM. Experience in real estate, PropTech, mobility tech or any other marketplace-based businesses is preferred. Fluent in English, Arabic essential. Other Capabilities Strong organizational, multitasking and time-management skills. Focused, reliable and responsible self-starter that can self-manage with good critical-thinking skills. Passion for helping customers succeed, combined with an affinity for metrics and analytics, are key to success in this role. Our promise to talent At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed. new_matches.description: Company Description Roboto is an education-focused organization dedicated to helping learners develop practical skills in coding, robotics, and STEM. The team designs interactive, hands-on programs that make technology and engineering concepts accessible and engaging for students of different ages. Roboto emphasizes project-based learning, creativity, and problem-solving to prepare learners for a technology-driven future. The organization values inclusive, supportive learning environments where instructors are encouraged to innovate and grow professionally. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Coding and Robotics Instructor role based in Qesm El Sheikh Zaid. The instructor will plan and deliver interactive lessons in coding, robotics, and STEM concepts, adapting teaching methods to different age groups and skill levels. Daily responsibilities include preparing course materials, leading practical workshops, supervising student projects, and ensuring safe and effective use of equipment and tools. The role involves assessing student progress, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear communication with learners and guardians. The instructor will also collaborate with colleagues to refine curricula, participate in training sessions, and support educational events and activities at Roboto. Qualifications Strong robotics skills, including hands-on experience with educational robotics kits and platforms. Proficiency in programming and coding fundamentals, preferably in languages commonly used in education (e.g., Scratch, Python, or similar). Solid understanding of STEM concepts and the ability to integrate science, technology, engineering, and mathematics into practical lessons. Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly and engage learners of varying ages. Experience in training or teaching, including planning lessons, guiding projects, and supporting different learning styles. Bachelor’s degree in Education, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Sheikh Zaid and manage classroom dynamics in a safe, inclusive manner. Organizational skills and reliability in preparing materials, maintaining equipment, and documenting student progress. Previous experience in youth education, after-school programs, or technology camps is an advantage.
